name: weather-dashboard-nodered
description: Node-RED runtime สำหรับรับข้อมูล sensor จากแดชบอร์ดแล้วเขียนลงไฟล์ CSV

scripts.seed-flow: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('flows.json')) { fs.copyFileSync('flow.json','flows.json'); console.log('seeded flows.json from flow.json'); }"
scripts.reset-flow: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('flow.json','flows.json'); console.log('flows.json reset from flow.json — restart Node-RED')"
